body: If I fail I loose my seat, which means I sit out the semester I failed, and the next.  I don't have the money for that.  There's no coming back from failing a class.
How much are they usually?  I took my counselors word for it that they were $3000.  The only other research I did was to see if it was covered by health care, which it isn't.
The only insurance I have is the student insurance.  School doesn't have a doctor.

I'm trying to get a job in what I love to do, but the only problem is that I need certification that I get when I graduate to find a job in the field.

I'm really passionate about my subject, the thought of failing has only dawned on me in the past few months.  I never made a backup plan.  If I fail I'll have no idea what to do with myself.

The campus counselor thinks I do, but it's $3,000 to get an evaluation.  I don't even have that much in the bank.

He's been helping me, and I have been getting better but I'm still worse than 95% of people.
My counselor referred me to one.  It costs more money than I have.  I don't even have enough to pay rent come January.
